sections.herbal_remedies:
ABOUT CANCER 
 The abnormal growth of cells is cancer. It grows out of control and affect the surrounding tissue and organs. With a period of time, toxins collect at the site of a particular organ; it may result in fatal growth in its surrounding cells. The groups of cells accumulate and produce swelling at the site. Nearby cells and tissues are also affected if the toxins are not removed as the infected cells are circulated to other parts of the body through the blood stream.
sections.types_of_cancer:
There are many types of cancers. Cancers are classified on the basis of type of cells that the tumor cell originated from. These include: 

 Carcinoma – Cancer derived from epithelial cells. This group of cancer is common. This cancer is of breast, prostate, lung, pancreas and colon. 
 Sarcoma – Cancer arise from connective tissues (bone, cartilage, fat, nerve). 
 Lymphoma and Leukemia – These are originated from cell that make blood. It is more common in children in comparison to other age groups. 
 Germ cell tumor – This Cancer is derived from pluripotent cells, more often present in testicles and ovary. 
 Blastoma – Derived from immature precursor cells or embryonic tissue.
sections.symptoms_of_of_cancer: There are more than 100 types of cancer which can infect any part of the body symptom and cause vary according to type and location of cancer.

sections.causes_of_cancer:
There are many reasons of cancer. 
 Some of the common reasons are: 

 Carcinogens like tobacco, arsenic, radiation etc 
 More exposure of sunlight and ultraviolet rays 
 Excessive use of alcohol 
 Obesity 
 Lack of physical activity 
 Damage or mutation in the DNA resulting in the damage to the genes involved in cell division. 
 Cigarette smoking 
 Exposure to radiation from X-rays, gamma rays, cellular phones and cell phone towers.
sections.diagnosis_and_tests:
Cancer diagnosis begins with physical exam and complete medical history. It includes laboratory test i.e. blood test, urine test, stool test may indicate cancer. 
 If tumor is detected then imaging test are helpful which are following: 

 CT scan 
 X-Ray 
 MRI 
 Ultra sound 
 Endoscopy 
 Biopsy
sections.treatment_of_cancer:
There are many types of treatments for cancer. It depends upon the type and stage of cancer. This may include radiation therapy, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, hormone therapy and surgery. 
 AYURVEDIC VIEW OF CANCER 
 Treatment of cancer by Ayurveda is varies in depth. It treats the disease according to the specific nature of the patient, the aggravated body energies involved and the body tissues are affected. Treatment does not only focus on the area of malignancy but on the entire body system.

Immunity restoring herbs and minerals are given to boost the strength of patient.
